content.comment_body: A [product_name] operator device can only communicate with one [product_name] module at a time. While there is a list of IP addresses for modules in the operator device, is there any software-based method (such as message text) to switch from one module to another without manually selecting in the menu? This is particularly challenging for basic users since the IP address setup is confusing.
No, the module selection can only be changed manually through the operator device’s own menu.

Hello, the only way to achieve this with [product_name] modules is to gather all data in one unit and connect the operator device to it. If you truly need to display data from two modules on a single HMI, an alternative panel such as those in the [product_name] family (e.g., KTP300/400) can do this. The programming software for the HMI is included in the starter kit for these modules. Hope this information is helpful.

If both modules are on the same network, you can transfer data from one module to the other using virtual mode. With the operator panel connected to the first unit, you are able to view data from the second module via the first. This is a possible solution.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering limitations in connecting an operator panel to multiple [product_name] modules simultaneously, causing confusion especially for basic users when working with several IP addresses. Manual switching via menus remains the only native method, and alternative approaches require either data consolidation or more advanced panels, exposing a gap in user-friendly multi-device monitoring in current hardware and software solutions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want to seamlessly switch the display on their operator device between multiple [product_name] controllers through software commands, avoiding manual menu navigation. The goal is an intuitive system for managing several controllers from a single interface.
